item.title: Gustave: The Giant Crocodile Burundi Can't Kill (The Real Story)
item.description:
Gustave is a giant Nile crocodile from Burundi's Ruzizi River and Lake Tanganyika, estimated at 18-20 feet and around 2,000 lbs, and blamed for as many as 300 human deaths. How much of that is documented, and how much is legend?
In this episode we separate the record from the myth: what naturalist Patrice Faye actually measured, why the death toll is disputed (later estimates are closer to 60), the bullet scars he carries, and the huge trap that stayed empty.
Gustave is estimated to have hatched around 1955. His last rumored sighting was in 2015, and reports of his death have never been verified.
